why_it_matters.text: A plant alkaloid from the autumn crocus, used for gout and pericarditis. It has been in the medicine chest since ancient Egypt.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 022351 in the Drugs@FDA data files.

description: A plant alkaloid from the autumn crocus, used for gout and pericarditis. It has been in the medicine chest since ancient Egypt.

parts.label: The amide group
parts.sentence: A C=O bonded to a nitrogen, the same link that joins amino acids in a protein. It is sturdy, and its nitrogen is not a base the way an amine's is.

parts.label: The ether oxygen
parts.sentence: An oxygen bridging two carbons, written C-O-C. It accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it is slow to react.

parts.label: The ring system
parts.sentence: Rings joined where they share atoms, or a single ring standing alone. Atoms in a ring are held in place, so this part keeps its shape while chains around it can bend.
